patterns.description: Dressed two-arm character places a prop to stop a door.

prop.description: Use the same prop in all three shots: boot or crate.

note.description: Action, consequence and state carried across the cut.

template.note: Open on the hand moving the spare boot into the doorway. A leaf blows inside. Eyes and head react, then the shoulders follow. Cut with the door already moving. The neck rotates about its joint and the shoulder and elbow move inside their parent groups. Feet stay planted. Keep the round face, teal knit cap and coral jacket consistent across shots. The far arm counterbalances the reach, recoils with the shoulder, and relaxes after the kitten crosses.

patterns.description: Prop anticipates contact, compresses, rebounds and settles before the reveal.

prop.description: Use the same prop in all three shots: boot or crate.

note.description: Action, consequence and state carried across the cut.

template.note: Cut to the same boot and left edge of the door. The boot stops the door at contact. A small face peeks through the remaining light.

patterns.description: Carry the same prop and character pose into the kitten payoff.

prop.description: Use the same prop in all three shots: boot or crate.

note.description: Action, consequence and state carried across the cut.

template.note: Return to the wide. Carry the stopped door, shoe and the character's recoil across the cut. The kitten crosses the threshold and comes toward the character. Hold the relieved face and the rescued kitten. The actor returns in the same pose, looks down, and relaxes at the hips. Keep the round face, teal knit cap and coral jacket consistent across shots. The far arm counterbalances the reach, recoils with the shoulder, and relaxes after the kitten crosses.
